basis.note: Presence in the accepted index is not permission to crawl; each host still needs an explicit owner admission, robots review and rights basis.

phases.name: compliance review
phases.exit: written admission of the source record

phases.name: /events, 20 accepted pages/day, 3 days
phases.exit: zero robots violations, zero off-origin requests, novelty recorded, acceptance >= 15%

phases.name: /events, 100 accepted pages/day, 7 days
phases.exit: acceptance >= 20%, no 429 storm, one recheck outcome recorded

phases.name: second path or second host
phases.exit: separate owner decision and admission record

removed_from_proposal.reason: unverified path; must not be proposed until its existence, stability and coverage by the same terms/robots rules are confirmed

pending: owner reads robots.txt manually and records agent rules, Crawl-delay and sitemaps
owner reads the terms of use and records the basis for fetching /events and for snippet indexing
owner confirms /events exists as a listing section and whether it paginates or uses filter parameters
owner confirms the user-agent contact address and takedown recipient
owner records an approve/deny/change-scope decision with date and reviewer

novelty.method: read-only comparison of canonical staging URLs against the pinned index pages table (SQLite mode=ro)
novelty.reporting_rule: daily acceptance is reported as novel_documents with the overlap stated alongside; the 107-page baseline is expected overlap from day one

redirect_policy.off_origin: refused even for public or separately admitted hosts
redirect_policy.logging: redirect_log rows plus report.redirects.by_decision and report.redirects.log

stop_conditions: fetch to a host without an admitted source, or indexing with index_allowed=0
any request inside a robots-disallowed path
any followed redirect outside the approved origin and path
robots 5xx or 403, or three consecutive 5xx from the host
429/503: honour full Retry-After, then stop the host for the run
any non-HTML response parsed or any body storage attempted
owner kill switch: set_source_enabled(source_id, false) and stop the scheduler
evidence_per_run: redirect log with decisions and reasons
probe versus link discovery counts (zero probes in Phase 1)
owner_decisions_required: confirm www.london.gov.uk and only the /events path (or substitute a host/path)
complete the manual robots and terms review and state the rights basis, including snippet indexing
confirm the contact address in the user agent and the takedown recipient
confirm 100 accepted pages/day, 300 fetches/day and zero probes in Phase 1
confirm retention (metadata plus snippet, no body)
authorise the first live request in writing
